name: Hotel Londra Palace
positioning: Londra Palace Venezia: a Venetian hotel welcoming travellers since 1853, a short stroll from San Marco, with lagoon-view balconies, writer-named suites and a rooftop altana terrace
best_for: Couples wanting a lagoon-view room with a Romeo and Juliet balcony
Travelers drawn to Venetian design and the hotel's literary and musical guests

facts.text: Londra Palace Venezia has been welcoming travellers since 1853.
The hotel is a short stroll from San Marco.
Rooms use Venetian materials such as brocade, silk, prized wood and marble.
Motifs borrowed from historic Veneto villas decorate the walls and floors of the rooms.
Classic Room City View rooms look over the city's rooftops, ancient lanes, churches and bell towers.
Each Junior Suite Lagoon View has a view of the lagoon and the island of San Giorgio.
The Suite Borges is dedicated to the Argentine writer Jorge Luis Borges and has Fortuny lamps and Murano vases.
Conde Nast Traveler reports Tchaikovsky stayed in 1877 and wrote his fourth symphony as he surveyed San Giorgio Maggiore.
Conde Nast Traveler says the property is a member of the Relais & Chateaux association.
Conde Nast Traveler says the roof terrace is one of the highest in Venice.
Guests can dine on the terrace as the sun sets over the lagoon city.
The LPV Bar serves signature cocktails.

highlights.text: The Deluxe Room Lagoon View With Balcony rooms are on the second floor with Romeo and Juliet balconies facing the lagoon.
The Top Floor Suite has a very large terrace with a view from the San Marco Basin to the Grand Canal.
The Junior Suites include two rooms dedicated to past guests Tchaikovsky and D'Annunzio.
The hotel has a rooftop altana terrace.
The Suite Jules Verne is named after the French writer, who stayed at the hotel in 1884.

considerations.text: Classic Room City View rooms have a view over the city with no lagoon view.
Conde Nast Traveler says the lagoon-side Riva degli Schiavoni has become overrun with crowds and souvenir stalls.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the exclusive Venice location.
